entries.title: The genome-coverage intake check, synthetic run 2
entries.what: One spent healthy atlas input read four ways by the one command: whole, chromosomes 1 to 8 only, 5 % of CpGs kept, chr17 removed.
entries.outcome: Met: whole and thinned pass; chromosomes 1 to 8 refused naming chr9 to chr22; chr17 removed refused naming chr17.
